title: Aar Ya Paar
description: Shekhar is having an affair with Anu, his wife's secretary. When the wealthy wife finds out and threatens him with dire consequences, Shekhar and Anu kill her. The police then find evidence against him, and he learns that Anu is likely to betray him.

title: Naya Din Nayi Raat
description: Sushma, a young girl, runs away from home to escape an arranged marriage; on her way, she meets many people, each representing a distinct facet of human nature, who help her in her difficulties.

title: Daraar
description: A hero comes to the aid of an Indian woman (Juhi Chawla) who rebels against a cruel, possessive husband (Arbaaz Khan).

title: Sultanat
description: Sultan, a brave warrior, tries to win the affections of Yasmin, a beautiful woman. However, his life turns upside down when his father is killed by a general, who he then swears revenge against.

title: Shiva Shakti
description: Shiva travels to the city to earn money for his sister Kusum's marriage. He meets Shakti, and they become friends. When Kusum gets pregnant with Shakti's child, Shiva vows to murder him.

title: Gurudev
description: A police inspector and his friend have grown up together, but the inspector's father works as the right-hand man of a crime boss who also happens to be the friend's father.

title: Pyaar Ka Safar
description: Bharat loses everything in childhood. His friend Bhargava supports him, but whether this helps or harms him remains uncertain.

title: Hiraasat
description: A police officer has two sons - one who follows in his footsteps, the other who leads a life of crime.

title: Jagan
description: Jagan befriends two women on separate occasions and they both end up falling for him. When he finds out that the two are sisters, he is left in a dilemma. Things take a turn for the worse when some goons force him to marry the elder sister.

title: Ajab Gazabb Love
description: Rajveer has a successful life until he falls in love with a woman who dislikes luxurious lifestyles.

title: Taqdeer Ka Tamasha
description: A single mother, Geeta, must deal with her two sons when both get into conflicts; the elder is Police Inspector Suryapratap, while the younger, Satya, is a hoodlum.

title: Mr. Natwarlal
description: Inspector Giridhari Lal is an upstanding lawman who takes care of his goofy younger brother, Natwarlal. However, when Giridhari becomes a nuisance to a seedy group of criminals, they decide to set him up and get him arrested on phony extortion charges. Natwarlal then decides to take revenge on the men who took down his beloved brother, so he concocts an intimidating alter ego and begins ingratiating his way up through the criminal ranks.

title: Dhadkan
description: Anjali (Shilpa Shetty) is madly in love with Dev (Sunil Shetty), but her family disapproves of the pairing, since Dev does not come from the appropriate financial and social background. Instead, Anjali's family has arranged for her to marry Ram (Akshay Kumar), who is rich. After initially rejecting Ram, Anjali begins to warm up to her new husband -- only to have everything turned upside down when Dev comes back into her life, having amassed a small fortune.
